claim: Flow cytometric analysis of PBMCs from 63 healthy volunteers at day 0 before vaccination (day 0), after removing age, gender, and ancestry effects by linear regression, showed that integrating pathway/transcript data with cell-population data predicted day 70 antibody-response endpoints less accurately than using cell populations alone.
reason: The comparison is about integrated models combining day 0 cell-population frequencies with pathway/transcript-derived features versus cell populations alone; the finding is not generated by flow cytometry alone but by downstream integrative modeling across assays.

claim: Flow cytometric analysis of PBMCs from 63 healthy volunteers at day 7 post-vaccination (day 7) showed that plasmablast frequencies were positively associated with microarray day 7 genes from ER stress, cell cycle, and N-glycan biosynthesis pathways.
reason: This is a cross-assay association claim linking plasmablast frequencies to day 7 microarray-derived gene/pathway signatures; it is not generated by flow cytometry alone.
